gate: independent synchronized station-to-vehicle raw fueling holdout

eligibility.required_rights: explicit public reuse or written permission for derived metrics and journal publication

candidates.title: NREL H2FillS product and manual
candidates.finding: The manual documents simulator inputs and output fields; the product download is registration-gated and does not expose an independent measured station-to-vehicle archive on the public product page.
candidates.reuse_status: software license is internal-use-only; no public raw empirical archive identified

candidates.title: NREL/NLR retail hydrogen station composite data products
candidates.finding: Public products provide distributions and aggregate station-use summaries, not synchronized station-to-vehicle pressure, temperature and mass-flow rows.
candidates.reuse_status: public report context; insufficient for numerical full-loop holdout

candidates.title: MetHyTrucks HySam system measurement data
candidates.finding: Open spreadsheets contain experimental pressure/temperature conditions for hydrogen sampling systems, but no vehicle-fueling station loop, dispenser mass-transfer trace or vehicle-side protocol record.
candidates.reuse_status: Zenodo dataset is open; scope remains auxiliary and cannot clear the full-loop gate

candidates.title: USN/FFI open-ended rectangular-channel hydrogen dispersion experiments
candidates.finding: CC BY 4.0 data provide temporal mass flow, filling pressure and 29 concentration channels for open-channel releases; they are not a station-to-vehicle fill trace.
candidates.reuse_status: CC BY 4.0; already bounded to detector/consequence auxiliary evidence

candidates.title: HSR-Rig-Project public hydrogen storage reactor logs
candidates.finding: The repository contains metal-hydride reactor absorption/desorption logs and is not a gaseous H70 station-to-vehicle fueling campaign.
candidates.reuse_status: public repository; excluded by apparatus and process scope

candidates.title: CARB Existing Light-Duty Hydrogen Refueling Stations In-Use Study Report
candidates.finding: The public report covers 22 stations and shows aggregate pass/fail results plus example plots. Appendix A states that individual results were tabulated in an Excel workbook, but no synchronized raw station-to-vehicle logger archive or reuse terms were found on the public report page.
candidates.reuse_status: public report; plot/aggregate only for this audit; not eligible for numerical full-loop holdout

candidates.title: NREL H2IQ high-throughput hydrogen fueling demonstration
candidates.finding: The public DOE slide/report gives one high-throughput event summary and protocol context but no synchronized pressure-temperature-mass-flow time series with vehicle-side raw channels.
candidates.reuse_status: public report; single summary event cannot satisfy the frozen >=8-case full-loop gate

candidates.title: NIST Hydrogen Field Test Standard
candidates.finding: The public NIST publication documents traceable field-test methods and metrology, but does not publish a synchronized HRS station-to-vehicle logger archive suitable for replay.
candidates.reuse_status: public methods paper; no raw validation set identified

candidates.title: European H2-Stations export API
candidates.finding: The public API provides station metadata and operational signals such as availability, usage, storage and pricing; it does not expose synchronized pressure, temperature and mass-flow traces for a fueling event.
candidates.reuse_status: CC BY 4.0 station context; not eligible for physics holdout

candidates.title: Cal State LA multi-year energy-performance and back-to-back fueling studies
candidates.finding: The publications describe large real-world operational collections and aggregate KPIs, but a public, machine-readable synchronized station-to-vehicle raw logger archive with reuse terms was not located.
candidates.reuse_status: publication/aggregate evidence only; custodial data request remains necessary

candidates.title: DOE TV024 CSULA Hydrogen Refueling Facility Performance Evaluation and Optimization
candidates.finding: DOE material confirms continuous station data collection and submission to the NREL Hydrogen Secure Data Center, while the public deliverable exposes summaries and instrumentation descriptions only; no synchronized raw logger export and reuse terms are published.
candidates.reuse_status: public project report; raw data custodial/secure and not eligible without release

candidates.title: Big Data Prediction in Hydrogen Gas Power Plant using Apache Spark
candidates.finding: The paper describes a facility-provided fueling dataset and predictive analysis, but the public PDF contains no machine-readable synchronized raw file, cryptographic archive or reuse terms for independent replay.
candidates.reuse_status: publication-only; raw dataset provenance/reuse remains unresolved

candidates.title: DOE/GTI delivered hydrogen fueling station performance project
candidates.finding: The public final report states that detailed station data were reported to NREL and aggregated because of confidentiality concerns; it does not release synchronized station-to-vehicle raw logs.
candidates.reuse_status: public report only; excluded from holdout

candidates.title: UCI NFCRC Gen IV hydrogen refueling station operational data
candidates.finding: The article describes real station fueling fields including event start/end, dispensed amount, hose/tank pressure and temperature, and ambient temperature, but the public article and OSTI record expose the publication/PDF rather than a machine-readable synchronized event archive with reuse terms.
candidates.reuse_status: real operational evidence and variable provenance only; raw logger release or custodian permission remains necessary

candidates.title: RHeaDHy public high-flow HRS test-matrix outline
candidates.finding: The open Zenodo record publishes the planned heavy-duty high-flow test campaign and its public review document, but no measured synchronized station-to-vehicle result files are attached.
candidates.reuse_status: open project documentation; protocol context only

candidates.title: DTU-TES Hydrogen Fuelling Station Library v2.1
candidates.finding: The open archive contains Modelica/Matlab SAE J2601 protocol and component models, not measured station or vehicle time-series observations; simulator output cannot be promoted to an external holdout.
candidates.reuse_status: open software/model reference; no empirical full-loop data

candidates.title: RHeaDHy Mid Flow Twin heavy-duty fueling campaign summary
candidates.finding: The 2026 public campaign summary reports 18 tests over six days, 60–300 bar initial pressure, ambient temperatures of 15–40 °C, more than 400 kg transferred and greater than 95% SOC, but no synchronized station/vehicle pressure-temperature-flow files or reuse terms are published. The European Commission CORDIS results page currently lists one public standardization deliverable and no dataset attachment.
candidates.reuse_status: real campaign summary useful for face-validity bounds; raw logger release or custodian permission remains necessary

next_action: Request a de-identified synchronized logger export and written reuse terms from CARB/HyStEP, NIST FTS, NREL/NLR HITRF, JRC GasTeF, FCH2RAIL, or an HRS operator; freeze the protocol and model before inspecting outcomes.
claim_boundary: This search record does not convert public summaries, simulator examples or component experiments into full-loop validation evidence.
